#: system collector: three text documents, each classified whole — the native format IS the payload (DESIGN 20), so there are no leaves for a dotted path to name.
#os-release: distribution constants, identical on every install of the distro, so the document travels verbatim — the same reasoning as the declaration's redaction_exemption. DELIBERATE EXCEPTION: the committed healthy variant plants a canary credential (se-canary-system-…) inside HOME_URL, a member the declaration does not serve. The canary is synthetic and identifies nobody; it exists so acceptance item 11 can prove the collector never emits what it did not declare, and scrubbing it out here would disarm the very check it is planted for.
#boot_id: formatless on purpose: the free-text pass substitutes the UUID shape-preserved (dashed, 5cb0-marked), which is what keeps the replayed begin record carrying a plausible boot id instead of a stub.
#bus.json: the request->document map behind system/time: two busctl GetAll replies, or `false` staging a call that failed at capture. Every member below is a D-Bus protocol constant, a signature, or a reading whose values on a LAB GUEST are distribution constants — pool.ntp.org names, Etc/UTC, poll bounds. COVERAGE, stated: an ESTATE host's timesync documents can carry internal server names, and a capture from one must not pass through these nothing-classed entries — reclassify ServerName and the server lists per leaf first.
